goal: Create the cyan code CLI package with entry points, config system, provider client, and basic runner scaffolding
summary: Phase 1 complete: Created the cyan-code CLI package with all core files — src/index.ts (CLI entry with argv parsing, config check, interactive onboarding), src/config.ts (ConfigService with API key storage), src/provider.ts (ProviderClient for opencode/mimo-v2.5-free), src/agent.ts (agent runner with buildSystemPrompt and runAgent), src/verify.ts (3-stage verification engine with validateStage1, validateStage2, runVerifyCommand), and test files (agent.test.ts, verify.test.ts). All tests pass, typecheck passes (`npm run typecheck` → `tsc --noEmit` → exit 0), and the CLI binary is ready for `pnpm --filter @workspace/cyan-code run`.
stepSummaries:
1. Create `packages/cyan-code/` directory with `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, and project skeleton [verified]
  2. Implement config system: `src/config.ts` — reads/writes config.json with API key, provider settings, model [verified]
  3. Implement provider client: `src/provider.ts` — wraps OpenAI-compatible API (opencode zen) with model ID `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free` [verified]
  4. Implement core agent runner: `src/agent.ts` — orchestrates task → agent → 3-stage verification pipeline [verified]
  5. Implement CLI entry: `src/index.ts` — command-line entry that accepts a task string and runs the agent [verified]
  6. Implement the 3-stage verification engine: `src/verify.ts` — Stage 1 (tool-call validation), Stage 2 (output double-check), Stage 3 (test-based verification) [verified]
